mapper.select: SELECT c.circuit_id, c.panel_id, c.channel_no, c.load_type, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at FROM circuit c INNER JOIN panel p ON p.panel_id = c.panel_id INNER JOIN site s ON s.site_id = p.site_id WHERE c.circuit_id = #{circuitId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
